name: iinpublic
description: IinPublic - Location-Based Chatbot Matching & Talk System

scripts.dev: node scripts/reset-dev-data.js && IINPUBLIC_STAGE_SEED=${IINPUBLIC_STAGE_SEED:-stage-zero} DEV_GUN_FRESH=1 npm run dev:run
scripts.dev:relay-only: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; RELAY_ONLY_HUB=1 STAR_SERVER_PERSISTENCE=ephemeral E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 tsx watch src/server/index.ts
scripts.start:lan-web: npm run build:embedded && IINPUBLIC_LAN_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=1 TLS_DISABLE=1 PORT=8080 node dist/server/server/index.js
scripts.dev:p0-talks: concurrently "webpack serve --mode development --config webpack.config.js" "tsx watch src/server/index.ts"
scripts.dev:multi: node scripts/reset-dev-data.js && DEV_MULTI_RESET_PROFILES=1 DEV_MULTI_BOOTSTRAP_IMPORT=1 IINPUBLIC_STAGE_SEED=multi IINPUBLIC_STAGE_ZERO_MAX_GLOBAL=4 DEV_GUN_FRESH=1 IINPUBLIC_P2P_BOOTSTRAP_PEERS="/ip4/127.0.0.1/tcp/4444/tls/ws/p2p/12D3KooWHiVVwUzdYE7kNB7CfcqgfQvkbMKrQvGZCyihmBCfRsgR" concurrently "npm run dev:relay" "npm run dev:run" "node launch-browsers.js"
scripts.dev:embedded-node: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; IINPUBLIC_EMBEDDED_NODE=1 IINPUBLIC_LOCAL_PORT=8088 IINPUBLIC_WEB_ROOT="$(pwd)/dist/web" tsx src/node-app/embedded-node.ts
scripts.build:embedded: npm run build:web && npm run build:server && node scripts/stamp-build-id.js
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:embedded && cd platforms/desktop && npm install && npm start
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:embedded && bash scripts/stage-desktop-prod-deps.sh && cd platforms/desktop && npm install && npm run dist
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build:embedded && bash scripts/stage-desktop-prod-deps.sh && cd platforms/desktop && npm install && npm run dist:win
scripts.desktop:dist:win:arm64: npm run build:embedded && bash scripts/stage-desktop-prod-deps.sh && cd platforms/desktop && npm install && npm run dist:win:arm64
scripts.desktop:dist:win:all: npm run build:embedded && bash scripts/stage-desktop-prod-deps.sh && cd platforms/desktop && npm install && npm run dist:win:all
scripts.test:e2e:embedded-node: npm run build:embedded && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 playwright test --config tests/e2e/embedded-node/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:native-app: npm run build:embedded && playwright test --config tests/e2e/native-app/playwright.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run build:android && npm run report:connectivity
scripts.test:all:legacy: npm run test:type && npm run lint && jest --forceExit && bash -c 'export E2E_BLOB=1; rm -rf blob-report blob-merged playwright-report; start=$(date +%s); PW_WORKERS=${PW_WORKERS:-12} npm run test:e2e:parallel; light=$?; npm run test:e2e:heavy; heavy=$?; mkdir -p blob-merged; cp blob-report/*/*.zip blob-merged/ 2>/dev/null; npx playwright merge-reports --reporter html blob-merged; end=$(date +%s); dur=$((end-start)); echo "\n[test:all] e2e light=$light heavy(+mesh)=$heavy | total $((dur/60))m$((dur%60))s | one combined report: npx playwright show-report"; exit $(( light || heavy ))'
scripts.health: npm run test:type && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.test:unit+e2e: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:parallel: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 E2E_SKIP_HEAVY=1 PW_WORKERS=${PW_WORKERS:-12} DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:heavy: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 E2E_SKIP_FIND_SIMILAR=1 E2E_SKIP_ALL_MESH=1 PW_WORKERS=${PW_HEAVY_WORKERS:-2} DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage4-four-user tests/e2e/talks-matching tests/e2e/staged/stage2-two-user/01-login-two-users-headcount.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/02-multi-user-headcount.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/09-four-types-chatbot.spec.ts && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 E2E_SKIP_ALL_MESH=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/mass && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 E2E_SKIP_FIND_SIMILAR=1 E2E_SKIP_ALL_MESH=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage5-multi-user && npm run test:e2e:mesh && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage5-multi-user/find-similar-people.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:mesh: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=${PW_MESH_WORKERS:-4} DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/01-mesh-ping-overlay.spec.ts tests/e2e/talks-matching/03-mesh-response-match.spec.ts tests/e2e/talks-matching/04-local-contacts.spec.ts tests/e2e/talks-matching/05-mailbox-offline-response.spec.ts tests/e2e/talks-matching/06-sender-suppression.spec.ts tests/e2e/talks-matching/07-change-of-mind.spec.ts tests/e2e/talks-matching/08-retraction.spec.ts tests/e2e/talks-matching/09-exchange-suppression.spec.ts tests/e2e/talks-matching/09-ipfs-auto-share.spec.ts && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/06-mesh-ping-with-hub-api-down.spec.ts && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/07-mesh-ping-after-hub-stop.spec.ts && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/02-mesh-broadcast-announce.spec.ts --grep 'find-similar broadcast' && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/02-mesh-broadcast-announce.spec.ts --grep 'ipfs attachment'
scripts.test:e2e:p0-talks: npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 DISABLE_HMR=true PW_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage2-two-user/00i-p0-direct-talk-delivery.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 DISABLE_HMR=true PW_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/platform-smoke --grep @smoke
scripts.test:e2e:device-profiles: npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 E2E_DEVICE_PROFILES=1 DISABLE_HMR=true PW_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/platform-smoke --project=iphone-webkit --project=android-chromium

scripts.test:e2e:cross-platform: npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 DISABLE_HMR=true PW_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/cross-platform
